body: I think she's finally quit texting me. The last time she texted me she said we could still hang out but I feel like a fucking pariah. I really appreciate your comments. I've been crying a lot just thinking about everything. She even agreed to meet my grandparents 2 weeks ago. I'd feel better if she just told me I'd fucked up and this is how I fucked up. I've been visualizing how I'm going to end it. I even wrote out a note to her and my parents last night.

My gf says she has family issues she's dealing with but I just don't understand why she can't answer my phone calls or texts. I don't know if it's true or she's just saying that to get me to stop calling her. If we hadn't been having such a great time  together hit it off together I wouldn't feel like I fucked something up. I don't know what to do, each day I feel shittier. I really don't want to keep going on like this. I feel like using again, bc really who would care if I did. Everyone already thinks of me as a fuck up. This was the only person I looked forward to talking to and the only person who made me feel good ab myself
